title: Nonmonotone subgradient methods based on a local descent lemma
abstract: arXiv:2510.19341v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper we present a nonmonotone line search subgradient algorithm tailored to upper-$\mathcal{C}^2$ functions. This is a family of nonsmooth and nonconvex functions that satisfies a nonsmooth and local version of the descent lemma, making them suitable for line searches. We prove subsequential convergence of the proposed algorithm to a stationary point of the optimization problem. Our approach allows us to cover the setting of various subgradient algorithms, including Newton and quasi-Newton methods. In addition, we propose a specification of the general scheme, named Self-adaptive Nonmonotone Subgradient Method (SNSM), which automatically updates the parameters of the line search. Particular attention is paid to the minimum sum-of-squares clustering problem, for which we provide a concrete implementation of SNSM. translated_title: 基于局部下降引理的非单调次梯度方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种专为上-$\mathcal{C}^2$函数设计的非单调线搜索次梯度算法。上-$\mathcal{C}^2$函数是一类非光滑非凸函数，满足下降引理的非光滑局部版本，因此适用于线搜索。我们证明了所提出算法的子序列收敛性，即收敛到优化问题的驻点。我们的方法涵盖了多种次梯度算法的设置，包括牛顿法和拟牛顿法。此外，我们提出了该通用框架的一个具体化版本，称为自适应非单调次梯度方法（SNSM），它能够自动更新线搜索的参数。我们特别关注最小平方和聚类问题，并为其提供了SNSM的具体实现。最后，我们通过数值实验展示了SNSM与其他方法相比的优势。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于局部下降引理的非单调线搜索次梯度算法，适用于上-C²非光滑非凸函数并证明了其子序列收敛性，同时给出了可自动更新线搜索参数的自适应版本SNSM，在最小平方和聚类问题上展现出优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a nonmonotone line search subgradient algorithm based on a local descent lemma for upper-C^2 nonsmooth nonconvex functions with proven subsequential convergence, and introduces the Self-adaptive Nonmonotone Subgradient Method (SNSM) that automatically updates line search parameters, demonstrating advantages in minimum sum-of-squares clustering.
